blurb: Guests sail the Severn River and Chesapeake Bay aboard S/V Celerity, a 47-foot Beneteau 473 sloop. Charters are private, fully crewed, and shaped around the guest's day with options for morning, afternoon, and evening sails. Up to six guests can enjoy a 2.5-hour cruise with snacks and non-alcoholic drinks provided, and guests may bring their own beverages and meals.
extraNote: Cancellations with 24 or more hours' notice accepted · Captain may reschedule at no cost if conditions unsafe · Payment due at completion of cruise; credit cards, Venmo, cash accepted · Tips optional but appreciated · Marina ten minutes from downtown Annapolis with parking and restrooms available · April through the end of October
